, Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily shifted the comparison to US-only release dates and concluded Taxi zum Klo was first in that context, despite the task asking generally which film was released first. This unnecessary scope change could have led to the wrong answer; the correct basis is the earliest original releases (Saajan Bina Suhagan 1978 vs. Taxi zum Klo 1980), under which Saajan Bina Suhagan is first.
